name: smwgraphics-super-robot-taisen-original-generation
title: Super Robot Taisen: Original Generation 2 - Final Mission
description:
The map of the final mission in Super Robot Taisen: Original Generation 2 (GBA), re-arranged as a background.

This is a HUGE background; it uses FG1, FG2, BG1, BG2 and BG3, only leaving FG3 free, but only some FG1 animations are compatible (see last screenshot), which needed to be set manually (of course they're already included in the sample level). It also uses almost 3 full Map16 pages.
